headline: Three mornings after the finish, the only file I hold is still 13 September - and the fix is a ten-minute job.
body:
Nothing has moved, and that is the read. **training.json** is stamped **17 September 17:20**, **134.8 hours** old, with **twelve** consecutive push windows missed. The newest session of any kind in it is Sunday 13 September - **66.70 km** on the bike, then **7.21 km at 6:10/km on 152 bpm** off it. Ten mornings now with no HRV, no resting heart rate, no sleep, so the readiness gate cannot be run and I will not pretend it can.

Today is calm and soaked: gusts only **27 km/h**, but **17.7 mm** of rain before 11:00. Keep it inside - rehab block twice, knee-to-wall **3 x 10** each side, and a flat **20-30 min** walk when it breaks.

Tomorrow is the window: **15 km/h** gusts early, no rain, **18-21 C**. That is your first spin - **45 min at 26-28 km/h on 131-150 bpm**, nothing over 150.

Charge the watch and force a sync. Then: four splits, and how the ankle is on stairs.
